IC-M1 completed at `15015d378b5b77b3bb11698809d1680d12b8a91c`.

The BT legs require local slots; the long triangular gaps also reflect the single-trapezoid constraint. An unadopted two-band option doubles chambers to 24 per end and reduces the geometric full-depth same-chamber loss from **30.15% to 19.17%**. This is not ACTS or reconstruction performance.

The three-band diagnostic adds little planar area and worsens full-depth availability; its outer band is **0.411 m**, below the old 0.50 m minimum.

All full-volume coil proofs, support/chamber SAT checks and negative fixtures passed. A million-ray cross-check agreed within 1.34σ. No repository files changed.
